# region imports
from AlgorithmImports import *
# endregion

class StaticPortfolioAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):
    _tolerance = 0.05

    def initialize(self) -> None:
        self.set_start_date(2022, 1, 1)
        self.set_end_date(2024, 12, 31)
        self.set_cash(100000)
        self.settings.seed_initial_prices = True
        
        # automatic_indicator_warm_up only supports automatic indicators, not manual indicators.
        self.settings.automatic_indicator_warm_up = True

        # Request SPY and TLT data to form a static portfolio.
        tickers = ["SPY", "TLT"]
        targets = [self.add_equity(t, Resolution.MINUTE) for t in tickers]
        self.set_portfolio_targets(targets, [0.6, 0.4])

        # Create a PortfolioRebalanceManager to manage the rebalancing schedule.
        self._rebalance_manager = PortfolioRebalanceManager(self)
        # Set the rebalancing strategy and schedule.
        self._rebalance_manager.set_strategy(lambda portfolio: (portfolio, 0.05, "SPY"))
        self.schedule.on(self.date_rules.every_quarter_start(), self.time_rules.at(9, 0), self._rebalance_manager.rebalance)

    def on_warmup_finished(self) -> None:
        self.set_holdings(self.portfolio, self.portfolio.targets)

    def _check_if_rebalance_needed(self, current: PortfolioHoldings, targets: PortfolioTargets) -> bool:
        for holding, target in zip(current.values, targets.values):
            weight = holding.holdings / self.portfolio.total_holdings_value
            if abs(weight - target.weight) > self._tolerance:
                return True
        return False

    def on_order_event(self, order_event: OrderEvent) -> None:
        super().on_order_event(order_event)
        # Rebalance if the rebalance manager indicates so and we have valid portfolio data.
        if self._rebalance_manager.should_rebalance and self.portfolio.total_holdings_value:
            self.set_holdings(self.portfolio, self.portfolio.targets)
